content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin International Degree-Seeking Students International Degree-Seeking Students Guidance and service For international students completing an entire study programme at HTW Berlin, the International Office offers special guidance and services.
